statistical_interpretation:
Evaluation performed using paired difference testing across EXP-20260913-010 and EXP-20260913-012.
• Workload Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.7319 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-2236.917, 1861.965]). Reason: Observed change 2.4% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Startup Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.2196 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-324.86, 776.644]). Reason: Observed shift 22.9% (threshold: 5.0%) is not statistically significant (p=0.2196 >= 0.05).
• Workload Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.2006 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-394.346, 1007.163]). Reason: Observed change 3.2% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Compute Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.7648 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-305.464, 260.45]). Reason: Observed change 0.7% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Workload Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.7165 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-616.967, 749.76]). Reason: Observed change 0.7% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Workload Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.7924 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-1059.277, 921.138]). Reason: Observed change 0.7% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Scroll Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.5099 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-461.669, 317.641]). Reason: Observed change 1.6% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Workload Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.0116 (statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [201.021, 553.473]). Reason: Observed change 3.0% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
• Playback Duration Ms (ms): p-value = 0.9260 (not statistically significant at alpha=0.05, 95% CI [-226.383, 215.601]). Reason: Observed change 0.1% (threshold: 5.0%) is within the acceptable engineering threshold.
